name: Night gallery
mood: A dark, warm room after hours. Each piece stands in its own pool of light, and the camera glides between them.
world: plinths, a floor that takes soft reflections, pools of light; the collection is visible beyond the hero piece

light.rig: two or three SpotLights with penumbra 0.6 from above, warm key, faint cool rim

motion: slow glides (damping 0.06), long holds, nothing bounces
signature: the first frame: one piece in a pool of light, the name set huge beside it
avoid: a black void: the floor must catch light
seenIn: Cartier Watches & Wonders 2026 (one room per piece)
a blind-test winner: a ceramics portfolio as a dark gallery with the collection on a table

name: Product noir
mood: A deep studio gradient, rim light carving the silhouette, enormous condensed type behind the product.
world: no room: a gradient ground, a soft floor shadow, type as architecture

light.rig: strong rim pair behind, a soft key in front, RoomEnvironment at 0.4 for reflections

type.scale: display set in caps at clamp(4rem, 14vw, 16rem), allowed behind the product; numbers set huge

motion: confident, quick in-out (power3), the product snaps into each pose and holds
signature: the product huge on the first screen, cut through by a giant word
avoid: three round buttons on a grey floor
seenIn: a blind-test winner: a shoe launch with a different hero angle per feature (sole-up for grip)
Oryzo by Lusion (one object, Z-axis camera)

name: Golden hour
mood: A small world at sunset. Long shadows, warm windows, and the page moves from late afternoon to dusk.
world: a diorama: land, the building, a path, a few hero props (a cable car, trees, a boat), lit windows

light.rig: low warm sun (DirectionalLight 8-12 degrees above the horizon) with long shadows, a cool sky fill

type.scale: display clamp(3rem, 8vw, 8.5rem) with an italic accent word, text 17px

motion: the camera travels (a CatmullRom path), the sun sinks with the scroll
signature: the first frame: the whole place, small and complete, in warm light
avoid: milk: fog or haze over the subject; every frame needs a true dark and a saturated colour
seenIn: a blind-test winner: a mountain hut at sunset with a cable car and lit windows

name: Toy box
mood: Bold scene colours, chunky bevelled things with stickers and labels, soft shadows, and pops that make you smile.
world: a desk-scale world of the subject's real artefacts (a laptop, stickers, a keyboard, tickets), a colour world per scene

light.rig: a palette-tinted hemisphere, a white key with a soft shadow, an accent rim

type.label: JetBrains Mono
type.scale: condensed bold display at clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 12rem), a serif italic for asides, mono for tags

motion: springy pops (back.out(1.6)) for drops and stickers, smooth damped scroll for the camera
texture: grain 8%, a dot grid on the ground
signature: the subject's own object covered in its real stickers, on the first screen
avoid: pastel mush: grounds keep the same lightness, change the hue
stickers that are not the subject's own
seenIn: furkanboran.info (the laptop with stickers, a colour world per scene)

name: Daylight still life
mood: A sunlit table by a window. The object photographed like a still life, with paper grounds and quiet serif type.
world: a tabletop, a window-light shadow (a cookie or a gobo pattern), a few honest props from the subject's world

light.rig: a soft key from one side like a window (DirectionalLight + radius 8 shadows), a pale fill, no rim

motion: gentle: the light moves across the table with the scroll, the object turns slowly between beats
signature: the object in raking window light, its texture visible
avoid: a cream-and-terracotta cliché palette without a reason from the subject
milk: fog or haze over the subject; every frame needs a true dark and a saturated colour
seenIn: product photography conventions: window light, a reflector, a flat lay from above

name: Blueprint
mood: The object as an engineering drawing come alive: exploded parts, callouts with real numbers, a cool technical palette.
world: a measured grid, leader lines from parts to labels, the assembly separating and rejoining

light.rig: even, cool studio light with an environment for edges; flat-ish so the parts read

type.label: IBM Plex Mono
type.scale: display bold clamp(3rem, 8vw, 8rem), numbers in mono with units

motion: precise: parts slide apart on rails (linear in, ease out), labels draw their leader lines
texture: a faint blueprint grid in CSS
signature: the exploded view, every part labelled with a real figure

name: Monolith
mood: A single glowing form over a dark, reflective landscape. The cursor reveals detail, and the scale feels architectural.
world: a reflective ground plane, low fog, one monumental object; small human-scale details for scale

light.rig: the object is the light source (emissive + a point light), a faint moon fill

motion: slow, heavy (damping 0.05); the cursor tilts the light, not the camera
signature: the monolith small in a vast dark landscape on the first frame
avoid: a glowing orb (it is the default)
bloom on everything: only the form glows
seenIn: Hubtown by Unseen Studio (a glowing monolith over a reflective landscape)

name: Fog flyover
mood: A cool morning flight over terrain. Fog in the page colour, and the camera banks along a route.
world: terrain from noise, a river or road as a line of light, the destination reached at the end

light.rig: a pale low sun, strong fog in the ground colour, a soft sky hemisphere

type.scale: display clamp(3rem, 8vw, 8rem), italic for place names

motion: a continuous glide along a CatmullRomCurve3, looking slightly ahead; ink switches to light as the grounds darken
signature: the first frame: the land under fog, the destination a small light far away
avoid: fog in a different colour from the page
dark ink on the darkest grounds
milk: fog or haze over the subject; every frame needs a true dark and a saturated colour
seenIn: Explore Primland (aerial terrain flythrough with fog)

name: Material lab
mood: Bright, precise, almost scientific. One object, a light ground that takes on the chosen colour, and the material is the hero.
world: an infinite light studio cove, one object, a swatch rail; the ground tint follows the active colourway

light.rig: a big soft key + RoomEnvironment at 0.8; specular highlights matter

type.label: Geist Mono
type.scale: display medium weight clamp(3rem, 9vw, 10rem), numbers huge

motion: inertia: the object keeps a little spin after a drag and settles; colourway swaps crossfade the materials
signature: the colourway switch: the ground and the light change with the material
avoid: a grey floor with OrbitControls and nothing else
swatches that are not the real materials
milk: fog or haze over the subject; every frame needs a true dark and a saturated colour
seenIn: Oryzo by Lusion (real material response, inertia)

name: Pavilion of rooms
mood: Each chapter is a room with its own colour and light; the camera walks from door to door.
world: rooms in a row or a ring, doorways framing the next room's colour, one item per room

light.rig: per room: a coloured area of light (RectAreaLight or a tinted hemisphere), warm practicals

motion: walk-throughs: the camera dollies through a doorway (fly-into) into the next room
signature: a doorway on the first screen with the next room's colour glowing through it
seenIn: Cartier Watches & Wonders 2026 by Immersive Garden (six rooms, one per watch)

name: Paper world
mood: A handmade diorama of paper and card: flat-shaded shapes, visible layers, soft pastels and gentle light.
world: layered card planes, cut-out trees and figures, a paper texture on everything

light.rig: a soft key with long soft shadows between layers, a warm hemisphere

motion: layers slide apart like a pop-up book; nothing moves faster than a page turn
texture: a paper texture on the ground and on the 3D (a CanvasTexture with fibres)
signature: the scene unfolding like a pop-up book on the first scroll
avoid: milk: fog or haze over the subject; every frame needs a true dark and a saturated colour
seenIn: Sleep Well Creative (an illustrated 3D world you scroll through)

name: Type in space
mood: The name is the object. Letters built in 3D, and the camera moves through and around them.
world: 3D letters (TextGeometry from a typeface JSON, or extruded SVG paths), a few real artefacts between them

light.rig: a strong key and rim to carve the letter edges, an environment for the bevels

type.scale: HTML type stays small; the 3D letters carry the scale

motion: the camera threads between letters; letters assemble from pieces on the first scroll
signature: the name in 3D on the first screen, readable at its rest pose
seenIn: Shopify Editions (type that scatters and reforms)
